name: find_item
description: Answers 'do I have this item, and where is it?' in one call. Searches the bank, inventory and worn equipment for an item name (case-insensitive substring) or an exact numeric item id, returning every match with its location, quantity, bank tab and slot index. USE THIS instead of pulling bank_snapshot or game_state to look for specific items: a bank runs to hundreds of entries, and this returns only the matches. Good for 'do I own a dragon defender', 'where is my whip', 'how many prayer potions do I have'. Bank matches come from the last bank snapshot, so they need the bank to have been opened once this session; inventory and equipment are live. It cannot see items on the Grand Exchange, in a looting bag, or on a deathpile.

query.description: Item name or part of one, matched case-insensitively (e.g. 'whip' matches 'Abyssal whip'). A bare number is matched as an exact item id instead.

containers.description: Which containers to search. Omit to search all three.

outputSchema.description: An empty matches array means the item was not found in the containers searched, which is not the same as the player not owning it: the bank may never have been opened this session (see bankAvailable).

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant, UTC. Transported as a JSON string; no native date-time type is implied.

bankAvailable.description: False means no bank snapshot exists yet, so bank matches could not be searched at all. Present only when the bank was searched.

note.description: Why a search returned nothing, when the reason is the query rather than the account.

matches.description: One entry per matching stack. The same item can appear more than once: worn, in the inventory, and in several bank slots.

qty.description: Stack size. 0 means a bank placeholder: the slot is reserved and the item is NOT owned.

equipmentSlot.description: Equipment matches only: worn slot name (HEAD, CAPE, WEAPON, ...).

tab.description: Bank tab holding this item; 0 is the main tab. Bank matches only.

placeholder.description: True when this is a reserved empty bank slot, not a held item.

bankSlot.description: Bank matches only: index in the bank container.

inventorySlot.description: Inventory matches only: index in the inventory container.

charges.description: Uses remaining, taken from the "(n)" suffix of the item name: teleports for jewellery like Ring of wealth (4) or Digsite pendant (5), doses for potions like Prayer potion(4). Absent when the name carries no such suffix. Charges held in a varbit instead (Xeric's talisman, tridents, tomes) are in game_state's charges section.
